name: documents
description: Create, edit and audit .docx documents: spec-driven generation (headings, tables, images, headers/footers, TOC), targeted edits, text extraction, two-layer validation and page-by-page visual acceptance.

description_i18n.en: Create, edit and audit .docx documents: spec-driven generation (headings, tables, images, headers/footers, TOC), targeted edits, text extraction, two-layer validation and page-by-page visual acceptance.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 创建、编辑与审查 .docx 文档：按规格生成（标题/正文/表格/图片/页眉页脚/目录）、定向改稿、抽取文本，以及交付前的两层校验与逐页出图验收。
